mia: FYI ran the hybrid allocator patch on paged-attn block-table (slab+bump->hybrid) against the long-seq benchmark. results look off — 4.8% median latency regression at seq=4096, p95 +9%. test harness: `bench/paged_attn/long_seq.sh --iters=100`.

raj: can you drop the repro + flamegraph? also which kernel variant (flash1/flash2/fused) did you use? :thinking:

mia: attached command and perf flame link, used `flash_attn_v2_fused` with `--kv-paging=on --alloc-mode=hybrid`:
```
./run_bench --model=llama-13b --kernel=flash_v2_fused --seq=4096 --batch=1 --iters=100 --kv-page-size=64k
```
flame: https://perf.redwood/graphs/1919992222-hybrid-run.svg

oliver: hmm could be kernel selection fallback. when pages are blocked we hit different CUDA kernels (softmax split) instead of the fused path. kernel trace shows calls to `softmax_k_small` rather than `softmax_k_xla` at high frag. try forcing `KERNEL_PREFERENCE=latency` to bias smaller-kernel selection and avoid large-warp kernels.

sasha: also noticed GC-like eviction storms in the kv pager during the run. try bumping `kv.pager.eviction_hysteresis_ms` and lowering slab watermark — in my quick local tweaks `eviction_hysteresis_ms=250` + `slab_watermark=0.6` reduced p95 significantly. config snippet:
```
kv:
  pager:
    eviction_hysteresis_ms: 250
  alloc:
    mode: hybrid
    slab_watermark: 0.6
```

mia: reran with those changes + kernel env, median returned to baseline but p95 still +3%. allocation stats: `allocs: hybrid: slab_hits=62% slab_misses=38% compactions=14`. attaching a profiler trace (heap/alloc timeline) and the flamegraph.

dan: proposal — do an A/B on staging: baseline (slab-only) vs hybrid vs hybrid+eviction-tune. SLO: median <= baseline and p95 <= baseline+2%. can we schedule canary tomorrow 10:00 PT? :calendar:

perf-bot: perf/regression-check failed on PR #4372 (paged-attn-hybrid) — regression 4.8% median exceeds threshold 3% — build 8241.

mia: noted. I'll push a follow-up that forces kernel preference for seq>2048 and includes the eviction tuning; will open an experiment PR and tag @eng-runtime for review. :eyes:

raj: please include the exact bench script, random seed, and env so we can reproduce deterministically. also add a synthetic that stresses compactions (randomized page churn) so we can surface regressions earlier. short-term fallback: gate hybrid behind a feature flag per customer.

oliver: one more ask — add `--collect-kernel-calls` to the bench runner so we can correlate kernel taxonomy with latency spikes and attach kernel histograms to the perf dashboard.

mia: done, PR 4378 opened with logs, bench scripts, and graphs; marking for canary deploy and will watch perf dashboard after the run. :party_parrot:
